params.body:
Makes main green after #213 (merged with a red CI). Four failures, four causes:

- ExportVehicleWindowsTest x2: the model used floor() on Carbon 3's float diff, while Delta's templates on Carbon 2 got an integer (truncated toward zero): on the end day the counter reads 1, not 0, and twelve days after the end the winner counter reads 3, not 2. The model now truncates (`wholeDaysUntil`), pinned against `cutover-baseline` (export/index.blade.php line 111 and 121 there); the tests describe that behaviour.
- RulesCoverageTest: the edited B1-6.2 row had lost its status cell, so the tool no longer recognised the rule the new test tags. Restored (`| code |`).
- UiApiUsageTest: the setWinner error handler had an `alert()` fallback; `ui.notify` only.

No other change.
params.title: Green main: bidding window arithmetic as the old templates, no alert(), rule row restored
